A few useful answers

Good questions.
Clear next steps.

A little clarity before you get in touch. We’re happy to talk through the details.

All common questions↗
Which classes does the school offer?+

Nursery to Class 12, with the RBSE pathway and Science, Commerce and Arts at senior secondary level. Please confirm subject combinations and current availability with the office.

How can I find out about fees?+

Ask the office for the current written fee structure for your child’s class. Our admissions page includes a budget planner for amounts from that quote.

Can we visit before deciding?+

Of course. Call or send an enquiry to ask about a suitable visit time. The office must confirm your visit; submitting an enquiry does not book a slot.

How do we ask about transport?+

Share your village or area with the office by phone or WhatsApp. Confirm route, pickup location, availability and charges directly before making plans.
